properties.mineralogy: Quartz arenite with subordinate siltstone, mudstone, and volcanic intrusion tuff
properties.drainage: Well-drained glacial till over fissured bedrock sloping northward toward the Water of Leith

properties.primary_surfacing: Historical whinstone and granite setts, cast asphalt carriageways, and Caithness flagstone pavements
properties.wear_characteristics: Polished stone crowns, tar infills in historic gutters, kerb drop wear, iron coal-hole covers
properties.micro_grading: Pronounced downhill gradient falling northwards down Wemyss Place Mews and Darnaway Street

properties.groundcover: Cultivated private gardens with ornamental shrubs and lawn in Queen Street Gardens West

properties.primary_building_typology: Neoclassical / Georgian Edinburgh New Town Ashlar Townhouses and Tenements (Reid and Sibbald design)

structures.name: Wemyss Place Corner Pavilion (West Flank)
structures.roof_geometry: Pitched Scottish slate with lead ridges, parapet gutters, and tall stone ashlar chimney stacks
structures.facade_material: Craigleith blonde sandstone ashlar with rusticated ground floor and giant Corinthian/Ionic pilasters
structures.weathering_patina: Deep charcoal-black historical coal-smoke soot crusting in window reveals, under fluted pilasters, and beneath projecting cornices; rain-washed golden-blonde upper ashlar

structures.name: Albyn Place / Wemyss Place Corner Block (East Flank)
structures.roof_geometry: Pitched slate roof behind balustraded and solid parapet, projecting stone chimney stalks with terracotta pots
structures.facade_material: Smooth-dressed sandstone ashlar with channeled rustication to base and molded entablature
structures.weathering_patina: Moderate soot deposition, lime runoff beneath sills, damp shadow staining on north-facing returns

structures.name: Wemyss Place Mews Lane Dwellings
structures.roof_geometry: Steeply pitched Ballachulish slate roofs with zinc flashing
structures.facade_material: Random rubble sandstone with dressed margins and lintels
structures.weathering_patina: Surface lichen, weathered lime repointing, carbon staining around carriage arches

period_vehicles: Modern executive saloons and hatchbacks parked along kerbside
street_furniture: Cast-iron fluted lampposts with Victorian lantern heads
Wrought-iron railings and urn-topped standards bounding the basement lightwells
pedestrian_profiles: Pedestrians in temperate urban commuter attire traversing flagstone walkways

properties.lighting_condition: Crisp temperate midday sun with delicate northern skylight fill and sharp raking shadow relief
